overall_assessment: When the Edutorium page holds a real plan, extraction is clean and complete (random controls 22, 24-27 are good). Two systematic problems remain: the 'dup_code' suspects are the catalogue's course-search list, not a plan, and many offerings carry the 'not yet published, latest version' fallback, i.e. another year's plan under this offering's year.

findings.evidence: Emnesøket gjelder kun fra 2022. Før dette må emnene finnes i studieplanen
findings.description: For courses 1-7 (mostly avviklet or status 3 offerings, and some active ones) the extracted text is the catalogue's course-search/index list (hundreds of 'code title' lines), not a course plan. Up to 35,000 chars of course lists, no learning outcomes, content or assessment. Same text shape for many different codes (dup_code). The page for the requested year does not exist and the site falls back to a search page; the list differs by year.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: URL /emne/<code>/<year-semester> for years before 2022 or for discontinued courses returns the 'Emnesøket' index page. .content-inner selector captures it without any check that the page is a plan.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat pages whose text starts with 'Emnesøket gjelder kun fra 2022' (or lacking 'Emnets innhold'/'Læringsutbytte'/'Emnekode') as not-a-plan: set extracted_text to empty/NA in post_fn or drop in the INN config, and avoid fetching offerings earlier than 2022.

findings.evidence: Emnebeskrivelsen for valgt semester er ikke publisert enda. Her er den siste versjonen vi har tilgjengelig.
findings.description: The page tells that the plan for the selected semester is not published and shows the latest available version instead. Start/teaching semesters in the text are 2024-2027 while the offering is 2022 or 2023 (e.g. 'Undervisningssemestre 2027 Vår' for a Vår 2022 offering). The text is a plan for a different year, with its own content/credits, and may even differ in title (MUS1005 Musikkformidling 3 vs 'Musikkformidling 4'). Roughly 15 of 28 courses in the packet show the banner (courses 8-21, 23, 28).
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Edutorium silently serves the nearest available version for years without a published plan; the banner 'Statusmelding' is captured as ordinary text and not used to mark the offering.
findings.suggested_fix: Detect the 'Statusmelding / ikke publisert enda' banner in post_fn (or a flag column) and either blank the text for that offering or mark it as a fallback-year plan so it is excluded or de-duplicated against the real year's offering; also strip the banner lines.
